about: The mutant ledger of internal/toolchain (wf10 TOOLCHAIN): the guards of the managed Go toolchain's fetch, verification, install and selection. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/toolchain; the runner judges it by the package's own tests (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: tc-hash-unchecked
mutants.rule: A zip whose h1 hash is not the checksum database's record is never installed.

mutants.name: tc-signature-unchecked
mutants.rule: A tree head counts only with a valid signature of the database's key.

mutants.name: tc-root-unchecked
mutants.rule: A record counts only when the tiles prove it a leaf of the signed tree.

mutants.name: tc-split-off-by-one
mutants.rule: The tree splits at the largest power of two below its size (RFC 6962).

mutants.name: tc-tile-path-groups
mutants.rule: A tile index of more than three digits is written in x-prefixed groups.

mutants.name: tc-no-lock
mutants.rule: Two installs of one release download it once: the second waits for the first's lock.

mutants.name: tc-no-recheck
mutants.rule: An install that waited on the lock uses the release the first one installed.

mutants.name: tc-never-installed
mutants.rule: A warm cache reads no network.

mutants.name: tc-not-executable
mutants.rule: The commands of bin/ and pkg/tool/ are executable, as cmd/go sets them for a toolchain.

mutants.name: tc-escape
mutants.rule: No zip entry is written outside the release tree.

mutants.name: tc-tree-left

if err := extract(z, path+"@"+version+"/", tree); err != nil {

mutants.rule: A refused install leaves no partial tree.

mutants.name: tc-zip-left
mutants.rule: A failed download leaves no partial zip.

mutants.name: tc-offline-silent
mutants.rule: GOPROXY=off with a cold cache fails at once and names the way out.

mutants.name: tc-proxy-missing-stops
mutants.rule: After a comma, a proxy without the module passes to the next.

mutants.name: tc-proxy-pipe-stops
mutants.rule: After a pipe, any error passes to the next proxy.

mutants.name: tc-proxy-comma-falls
mutants.rule: After a comma, a proxy error other than a missing module ends the list.

mutants.name: tc-select-no-install
mutants.rule: The managed toolchain is installed before a build runs it.

mutants.name: tc-system-is-managed
mutants.rule: ERGO_GO=system builds with the go command on PATH.

mutants.name: irt-cache-key-without-patch
mutants.rule: The patched compile is keyed by the patch: another patch of the same release is another compile, never the old one.

mutants.name: irt-wrong-go-pinned
mutants.rule: The patch is the one the lock ports to the release the build runs, not to the pin; a release without a port is refused.

mutants.name: irt-pin-unported
mutants.rule: The pinned release is one the IR patch is ported to (toolchain/ir/lock, ports.md). A constant has no coverage, so the anchor names its test.

mutants.name: irt-patch-digest-unchecked
mutants.rule: ergo applies a patch only at the content the lock records.

mutants.name: irt-patched-never-ready
mutants.rule: A built patched compile is reused: it is built once per release and patch.

mutants.name: irt-patch-no-lock
mutants.rule: Two builds that need the patched compile at once build it once: the second waits for the release's lock.

mutants.name: irt-patch-no-recheck
mutants.rule: A build that waited on the lock uses the compile the first one built.

mutants.name: irt-apply-no-offset
mutants.rule: A hunk applies where its lines stand, also when the release moved them.

mutants.name: irt-apply-fuzz
mutants.rule: A hunk whose old lines changed is rejected, never applied.
